objective: Broaden complete supplied-passage translation supervision after v2 requested-content omissions, without claiming old narrow targets were erroneous.
audit_findings: The old targets answered their actual narrow questions adequately; no clear material factual error was found in this AI audit. This is not proof of error-free targets.
The Hebrew textual subset had no explicit full-supplied-passage translation request.
The only two explicit complete multiverse translation tasks in the Greek textual subset were both validation examples, IG027 and IG036.
The Aramaic subset uses only single supplied verses; IA024 already requested a whole verse, while IA004 and IA014 requested selected parts.
All sixteen application examples are preserved. Their intent-based, Bible-based reflection contract remains unchanged.
limitations: All audits and separate source reviews were performed by AI agents with shared project context, not a human expert panel.
No causal link between missing training-task coverage and the v2 model omissions has been established.
Four Aramaic expansions cover individual verses only; multiverse Aramaic transfer remains untrained in this dataset.
The revision changes prompt scope, answer length and loss-token volume together; it is a bundled data-composition test, not a length-controlled causal ablation.
The selected modern editions are not autograph texts or a complete manuscript/context corpus.
No paid model calls, model training or quality measurements were performed in this preparation phase.
